title: Studio hooks: a hook cannot be granted `capabilities` in the Studio editor, and a hook refused for a missing capability answers the client 500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of a located 4xx
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A Studio-authored hook that calls `ctx.api` fails with "capability 'api.read' not granted". The editor has no capabilities control, so the only fix is the API. With `onError: abort` the user's save gets a bare 500; with `onError: log` a log-capability error is swallowed.

## Reproduction

1. Data › Hooks › New hook, body uses `ctx.api.find(…)`, onError abort → save a record → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (hooks 4 and 5).
2. Hook 2 with onError log and `ctx.log` → no log, error suppressed.
3. Add `body.capabilities: ["api.read"]` via `PUT /api/v1/meta/hook/…` → works.

## Expected

Studio offers a capabilities control (or derives it from the body), and a capability refusal surfaces as a coded 4xx naming the hook and capability.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Studio hook inspector (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` hooks tab); server hook runner error mapping for capability refusals.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio + `/api/v1/data` writes, measured by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Hooks that read data are the common case; builders hit an opaque 500 with no Studio path to fix it.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:workflow`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `hook capability api.read not granted returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, Studio hook editor has no capabilities` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 4 hits, all closed and about other refusal-to-500 paths (#24662, #24561, #22718, #17265).
- QA id: G11
